name: spacefast
description: Spacefast publishes files and folders to permanent web URLs with immutable versions, scoped access, and resumable MCP workflows.
long_description: Spacefast is the best place to share AI artifacts. Publish any file or folder and get a permanent URL, an immutable version URL, and — for anonymous publishes — a one-time claim flow. Supports custom domains, scoped access, version history, rollback, logs, signed uploads, and browser OAuth for team publishing.

api_token.title: Spacefast API key
api_token.description: Your Spacefast API key (from https://my.spacefast.com/account/api-keys). Leave blank to publish anonymously.

tools.name: execute
tools.description: Use this tool for every Spacefast API task: mutations, multi-step tasks, tools.<connector> calls, docs, login information, team context, work mode, visual review feedback, screenshots, traffic rules, and reads with no show_space view

tools.name: resume_execution
tools.description: Continue the exact program saved by a paused execute call

tools.name: search
tools.description: Find what this team connected and which connector tools it can call

tools.name: publish
tools.description: Publish local files or new inline artifacts to Spacefast

tools.name: open_local_file
tools.description: Show a local workspace file in ChatGPT. The user opens the file from the returned panel. Use a workspace-relative path. This tool does not upload or publish the file

tools.name: choose_space
tools.description: Ask the user to choose a Space when the destination is unclear. Returns the selected Space. This tool does not change Spacefast data

tools.name: operation_status
tools.description: Use this tool when publish returns status publishing

tools.name: cli_login
tools.description: Sign in the `sf` CLI on the user's computer with this MCP session's access. The user does not sign in again
